title: Tor amplitude for categorical pro-etale coefficients
statement: Let $X : \mathrm{Scheme}^{u}$ and $\mathcal A : \mathrm{Type}\,u'$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] with morphisms in universe $u+1$, equipped with a symmetric monoidal closed structure, additive tensor product in both variables and functorial flat resolutions. On $\mathcal C=\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal A)$, using the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site], sheafify the objectwise tensor and derive it using K-flat resolutions; this is the source's canonical derived tensor on $D(\mathcal C)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For arbitrary integers $a,b$, define categorical Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ for $K\in D(\mathcal C)$ by requiring that for every $F\in\mathcal C$, the cohomology of $K\otimes^L F[0]$ is zero in every degree $q<a$ or $b<q$. No order hypothesis $a\le b$ belongs to this predicate (the flat-model theorem assumes it separately), and the test sheaf is arbitrary, without constructibility or flatness assumptions.
